License.title: License
License.description: Represents a trading bot access license key bound to a unique hardware/browser fingerprint

key.description: Unique license key in format TL-DURATION-HASH

boundDeviceId.description: Hardware/browser fingerprint bound permanently to this license

activatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of initial activation on bound device

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the license expires

notes.description: Admin notes or assigned client name

createdBy.description: Admin UID or email who generated the key

SystemSetting.title: SystemSetting
SystemSetting.description: Global settings for Trade Lens AI, including Gemini API configs and usage stats

geminiApiKey.description: Admin-configured Gemini API key or proxy settings

apiUsageCount.description: Total number of binary options signals generated

activeUsersCount.description: Cached or real-time count of active devices

systemNotice.description: Broadcast message shown inside the bot widget

SignalLog.title: SignalLog
SignalLog.description: Historical audit of generated binary signals and analysis

licenseKey.description: The license key used to request the signal

/licenses/{licenseId}.description: License keys generated by admin, queried and updated by bot script upon device validation

/system_settings/{settingId}.description: Global application configuration and analytics counters

/signal_logs/{logId}.description: Audit trails for binary signal scans
